patch_description: This crossover retains the fast multi-start unrestricted packing search and structured antipodal line seeds from the current implementation, while incorporating the logarithmic soft-min/soft-max objective and exact-ratio backtracking polish from the inspiration program. The main search uses pair-vector operations only over the 91 distinct pairs, avoiding full distance matrices. The final sharp continuation accepts only strict improvements in the true squared min/max distance ratio, preserving the best discovered configuration and improving local contact balancing.
